text.tspan: "explanation": "Switzerland is not among the countries of Headless (DE, GB)", … },
"explanation": "\"SUMMER26\" belongs to \"Summer Sale 2026\", but it ended on 2026-08-31", … } ],
Two things, straight from Shopware's own cart:
1. Switzerland is not a country of the Headless channel (only DE and GB), so the order is
blocked before payment. Add Switzerland to the channel's countries.
2. SUMMER26 exists, but "Summer Sale 2026" ended on 31 August. The message is right.
The search itself works; SW10002 is simply not visible in the Headless channel. Add Headless
under the product's visibility and it will show up for "steel shirt".
